verdict.rationale: Deepgram's developer docs list official SDKs for Python, JavaScript, Go, .NET and Java, and its live-streaming guide is built around using those SDKs, so building against official SDKs is clearly supported. The evidence is mostly a list mention plus one guide, with no detail on what each SDK covers. Missing for 10: per-SDK documentation depth (API coverage for agent/TTS/streaming, versioning, maintenance status), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
